about_the_game:
Noir Tycoon puts you in charge of your own 1960s crime empire.

Manage illegal rackets and expand your territory across a city ruled by corruption and ambition. Bribe police to keep the heat low, upgrade your businesses, and outsmart rival families as you rise through the underworld.

Every decision matters: invest in profitable operations to grow your income or build influence to control the city’s power structures. Earn respect, balance loyalty within your crew, and make the tough calls that define your legacy.

Can you survive the game of crime, power, and respect — and become the city’s most feared boss?

🗺️ Build a Criminal Empire

Expand territory block by block, take control of businesses, and dominate the city in the 1960s underworld.

🎯 Turn-Based Turf Wars

Assign crew members, raid rival buildings, and outsmart enemy families through tactical attacks.

👥 Crew Management & Mafia Hierarchy

Build a hierarchy and upgrade attack/defense stats to shape your family’s strength.

🕰️ Dynamic Day & Night Cycle

Operations, income, police pressure, and crime chances shift depending on the time of day.

🔥 Heat System

Every crime raises attention. Too much heat triggers police investigations, arrests, and raids.

👮 Police, Lawyers & Justice

Crew members can get arrested—pay lawyers, bribe officials, or let them rot.

💼 Diplomacy & Trade

Negotiate alliances, trade agreements, ceasefires, and political favors.

🕊️ Respect & Loyalty

Your reputation unlocks political access, crew obedience, cheaper bribes, and new opportunities.

🏛️ Business Management

Capture businesses, upgrade income, and turn legal fronts into criminal profits.
